meta.title: Siaya County budgets and spending by department, FY 2014/15 to FY 2025/26 (county documents)
meta.rule: Every value is printed in a County Treasury document: the programme-based budget (PBB) for budgets, and the County Budget Review and Outlook Paper (CBROP) for the final budget and actual spending of the year it reviews. Values are kept as printed (KSh, whole shillings), with the document, table and PDF page. A department is matched to a code by its printed name (crosswalk); a name that matches no code, or more than one, is listed in unmatched and its values are not stored. Totals are the printed Total rows: sum_checks compares each with the sum of the department rows and row_checks compares recurrent plus development with the printed total; a document that does not add up is flagged, never corrected. Gaps are listed, never filled. Budget versions: original (approved in June), supplementary (a later approved revision), final (the budget the CBROP reviews, after all supplementaries). includes_balance_bf says whether the budget includes balances brought forward from the previous year (true, false, or null when the document does not say).
meta.read_method: PDF text layer (pdftotext -raw, reading order); number cells that the PDF wraps over two lines ("808,171,75" / "1") are joined only when the join gives a well-formed number. Every value is machine cross-checked against the page (scripts/machine-check.js).
meta.confidence_scale: 5 = clean printed table read twice; 4 = clean table or exact printed figure; 3 = rounded narrative figure, or OCR of a scanned page; 2 = chart label or garbled text layer; 1 = not used
meta.review: Provisional: awaiting editorial review. No value is approved; review records go in data/reviews.json (lib/review-status.js).

gaps.reason: No programme-based budget for FY 2013/14 was found; the CBROP 2014 prints only the economic classification.
The PBB 2017/18 is not in the KIPPRA repository or the other hosts searched (27 Nov 2026); the CBROP 2018 gives the original and supplementary totals by department only.
The CBROP 2018 prints absorption for the whole county only.
The PBB 2022/23 text layer splits every character with spaces and drops word breaks; the tables need OCR before they can be read.
The CBROP of September 2023 (reviewing FY 2022/23) was not found; the KIPPRA record labelled 2023 is the September 2024 paper.
The CBROP 2015 prints department actuals for development only.
The CBROP 2025 (GOV-03) is held but its department tables are not yet transcribed.
